hotel_name: Super Hotel O Shalimar Bagh Max Hospital

positive_snippets: The overall management was upto mark .The service and the behaviour of the staff was good.
Nice hotel and helpful staff with nice nature and behaviour
negative_snippets:
Fraud! Fraud! Fraud!
I booked this hotel online, but when I arrived at 11:00 pm, the property was completely closed and locked. There was no staff, no signage, and no way to access the hotel. All contact numbers provided were invalid, and there was no way to reach anyone for help.
To make things worse, I later received a call requesting prepayment, which was extremely suspicious. Thankfully, I refused. If I hadn’t, this would have been an even bigger loss.
Do not book this hotel. You may end up stranded late at night with no accommodation and no support. This listing should be investigated and removed.
